x: Stone had increased his lead when they came round again and although Len Herbert was still with Butler and Wheeler of Surrey, with Les Stokell close behind the rest of our chaps had fallen back and we were hoping for a usual last lap Belgrave effort.

After one lap he was still in the twenties and although he began to make ground on the second circuit it was a slow and painful business against such opposition as Adcocks and Kilby (Coventry), Rose, Wheeler and Wyatt (New Zealand), Tulloh, Roberts and Barlow.

Geoff North finished 7th but must have got some satisfaction in beating Najde of Sweden, who defeated both the North brothers in the final North Surrey League fixture last winter. 1500m 1.Wheeler (Australia) 3:47.9 2.J.Thresher 3:48.3 5000m 1.K.Keino (Kenya) 13:29.8 | 3.Temu (Kenya) 13:57.6
